review: All seven pages visually reviewed. PDF has outlined/rasterized text; empty text extraction is expected. Specifications manually transcribed from page 6.

400.status: Requested by user; not covered in provided brochure. Do not copy technical values, model, price or dimensions from 500 kVA.

640.status: Covered by brochure but not requested by user. No need to add this to requested catalog.

safe_descriptive_features.text: Twin configuration supports parallel or single-engine operation to suit demand.
Intelligent synchronization shares workload across the two engines.
Remote monitoring described for operating hours, engine health, RPM and error logs through app/web platforms.

uncertainties: The supplied brochure does not establish specifications or availability of the requested 400 kVA (200 x 2) configuration.
Product photograph appears on the cover for the 500 and 640 kVA family; it is not uniquely labeled as a specific model. Caption it as a representative twin DG image.
Page 6 says rated power output 620 hp for the 500 kVA column without expressly saying per-engine or total. Preserve 620 hp as printed without inventing interpretation.
No product price, tax rate, delivery time, warranty duration, sound level, equipment weight or explicit CPCB IV+ certification statement is supplied in this brochure.
Dimensions explicitly approximate. Do not remove that qualification.
Fuel consumption and emissions savings on page 4 are marketing claims (up to 40%) without a specified test basis; avoid turning them into a guarantee.
